title: Predictive warming (controller TC02, synthetic forecast input)
purpose: A synthetic forecast risk (P_below_hypo_20 crosses 0.3 at 300 s) is confirmed over two twin updates; the controller enters PREDICTIVE_WARMING at 370 s and raises all four channels with the PI law, capped at 40 %.
data_source: Controller: Suchitha's supervisory controller test TC02 (SIMULATED test bench, controller/neram_ctrl). Twin fields: test-bench stand-in values the controller received (SIMULATED).
loop_description: Open loop: the synthetic twin input does not respond to heating (no patient plant).
limitations: Synthetic constant T_est 36.5 degC and stepped forecast probability; not a forecast made by the twin.

Controller: Suchitha's supervisory controller design (v2 specification); Python fallback code rebuilt by Sai on 18 Oct 2026 from that specification (reproduces her v2 logs byte for byte). Not a Simulink/Stateflow model.

Twin fields are test-bench stand-ins (synthetic inputs or a first-order filter stand-in), NOT the NERAM twin. The forecast is the stand-in's flat persistence (T_pred = T_est) with normal bands from T_est_sd.
Hardware signals and module temperatures come from test stand-ins; no hardware exists. Thresholds are placeholders (Shreehan, TBD).
No clinical, hardware or treatment claim is made.
